Rotation.RotationNotes:
PvP_BG Blood copy for Sonaradk (Isle of Conquest / BG). Cloned from Blood_PvP_Burst_DarhangeR.
FIXES vs original (Sonaradk log: 205 fails vs 19 casts, Plague 118 fails 0 lands, 0 DS/HS/FS, 0 dmg on Demolisher): - PvP_BG:Icy Touch / PvP_BG:Plague Strike: original else-branch returned true with NO range check (Out of range + Not yet recovered wall). Now rangeCheck in both branches. - Vehicle blacklist (Demolisher ate runes for 0 dmg): skip UnitHasVehicleUI + vehicle GUID + Battleground Demolisher name. Plus -- Offensive Spells -- inserted after Mouseover as global vehicle/immunity skip. - PvP_BG:Death Strike: original locked behind FrostFever + BloodPlague (never applied, 0 DS while trained). Falls back to weak DS when self HP < 85%% and rune pair ready (heal + dump beats capped runes). - PvP_BG:Heart Strike: falls back without diseases when a Blood/Death rune is ready in melee. - PvP_BG:Death Grip: original + focus vehicle guard; still holds grip when focus already in melee.
